'Reproductive age' is not defined numerically in the section text, so the age bound is encoded as uncomputable rather than approximated with an invented age range. If the clinic adopts a numeric definition, it must be added as a derived criterion and go to human review.
No screening interval is stated; the measurement-year numerator window is a derived assumption flagged for human review.
Pregnant and postpartum women are explicitly included but are a subset of women of reproductive age, so no separate criterion was added.
Referral to or provision of evidence-based multicomponent interventions for those who screen positive (referenced in 'Practice Considerations') is not represented.
Information on IPV in men is referenced in 'Practice Considerations' and is not represented. No rule covers men.
Caregiver abuse of older or vulnerable adults (part of the topic title) is not addressed by a recommendation in this section and is not represented.
The asterisk after the date ('June 2025 *') is unexplained in the section text; its meaning was not captured.
The concept ipv_screening is used from the vocabulary; encoding it as an encounter type may need adjustment depending on how the EHR records IPV screening instruments.
